fe3dc0ea0b32a927bdccd4a3a4656e39ef9087ea.sourceText: Point-LIO 配准点云已经使用 `mapping.extrinsic_R/T`，而位姿发布直接取滤波器的 IMU 位置和姿态。当前实物 `extrinsic_R` 为单位矩阵，`extrinsic_T=[-0.011,-0.02329,+0.04412] m` 非零；轴向一致不代表两个原点相同。缺少这一步时，雷达绕 IMU 转动的杆臂效应可能表现为位置误差。单纯改 `lidar_frame` 或话题名无法补齐外参；先记录这一接口缺口，工程修改另行授权。
fe3dc0ea0b32a927bdccd4a3a4656e39ef9087ea.translatedText: Point-LIO The registered point cloud already uses `mapping.extrinsic_R/T`, while pose publishing directly takes the filter's IMU position and orientation\. Currently, the physical `extrinsic_R` is the identity matrix, and `extrinsic_T=[-0.011,-0.02329,+0.04412] m` is nonzero; axial alignment does not mean the two origins are the same\. Without this step, the lever\-arm effect of the lidar rotating around the IMU may manifest as position error\. Simply changing `lidar_frame` or the topic name cannot fill in the extrinsics; record this interface gap first, and engineering modifications are separately authorized\.

| **Operator Type** | **Purpose**                               |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Arithmetic operators     | Used to perform the four basic arithmetic operations                       |
| Assignment operators     | Used to assign the value of an expression to a variable               |
| Comparison operators     | Used to compare expressions and return a true or false value |
| Logical operators     | Used to return a true or false value based on the value of an expression       |
